name: Production
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
concurrency:
  group: production
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with: {version: 10.31.0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22.22.0', cache: pnpm}
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm check
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: node scripts/local-qa.mjs
      - name: Require an approved merge or an explicitly authorized bootstrap SHA
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          BOOTSTRAP_SHA: ${{ vars.MEALCHECK_BOOTSTRAP_SHA }}
        with:
          script: |
            if(context.ref !== 'refs/heads/main') throw new Error('Production only accepts main');
            const repo={owner:context.repo.owner,repo:context.repo.repo};
            const prs=await github.paginate(github.rest.repos.listPullRequestsAssociatedWithCommit,{...repo,commit_sha:context.sha,per_page:100});
            for(const pr of prs){
              if(!pr.merged_at || pr.base.ref!=='main' || pr.merge_commit_sha!==context.sha) continue;
              const reviews=await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.listReviews,{...repo,pull_number:pr.number,per_page:100});
              const latest=new Map();
              for(const review of reviews) if(['APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED','DISMISSED'].includes(review.state)) latest.set(review.user.login,review.state);
              const approved=[...latest].filter(([user,state])=>user!==pr.user.login&&state==='APPROVED');
              const blocked=[...latest.values()].includes('CHANGES_REQUESTED');
              if(!blocked) for(const [username] of approved){
                const {data:permission}=await github.rest.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({...repo,username});
                if(['admin','maintain','write'].includes(permission.permission)) return;
              }
            }
            if(context.eventName==='workflow_dispatch' && process.env.BOOTSTRAP_SHA===context.sha) return;
            throw new Error('No approved merged PR. Direct pushes are not deployed. Initial deployment requires a manual run and MEALCHECK_BOOTSTRAP_SHA set to this exact commit.');
  deploy:
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: production
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
      CF_PRODUCTION_D1_ID: ${{ vars.CF_PRODUCTION_D1_ID }}
      CF_PREVIEW_D1_ID: ${{ vars.CF_PREVIEW_D1_ID }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with: {version: 10.31.0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22.22.0', cache: pnpm}
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: node scripts/configure-cloudflare.mjs production
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm run deploy
      # Database schema changes are reviewed and applied separately with a backup.
      # CI never imports private backups or runs destructive/data migrations.
